tool.name: nf-core eggnogmapper
tool.description: Fast genome-wide functional annotation through orthology assignment.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ if [ "$is_compressed" == "true" ]; then gzip -c -d $fasta > $fasta_name fi
emapper.py \\ --cpu ${task.cpus} \\ -i ${fasta_name} \\ --data_dir ${eggnog_data_dir} \\ -m diamond \\ $dmnd_db_arg \\ $database_arg \\ --output ${prefix} \\ ${dbmem} \\ $args
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": eggnog-mapper: \$(echo \$(emapper.py --version) | grep -o "emapper-[0-9]\\+\\.[0-9]\\+\\.[0-9]\\+" | sed "s/emapper-//") END_VERSIONS ]]>
